name: Xai
rootCause: Xai, a Layer 3 solution for AAA gaming, has issued an alert for phishing impersonating Xai, where attackers have fraudulently obtained approximately $374 ETH, valued at approximately $845.8K.

descriptions.text: Xai, a Layer 3 solution for AAA gaming, has issued an alert for phishing impersonating Xai, where attackers have fraudulently obtained approximately $374 ETH, valued at approximately $845.8K.

Xai suffered a reported social-engineering incident on Ethereum on 2023-12-07. Publicly available records classify the event as an impersonation scam with approximately $845,800 in losses, but no primary disclosure, attacker address, or verified exploit transaction has been identified in the available evidence. The available evidence describes the incident as a social-engineering and impersonation scam affecting Xai-related assets on Ethereum. No public postmortem, verified transaction trace, or technical disclosure was identified, so the exact compromise path and affected accounts remain unknown.
